changes.title: Change history
changes.description: Review workspace changes and undo anything that is still safe to reverse.

commandPreview.title: Confirm related changes
commandPreview.description: These items will change together. Cancel keeps your current input. If anything has changed when you confirm, the whole group is rejected.
commandPreview.moveToList: Move to list "{{name}}", and move subtasks with it
commandPreview.moveToInbox: Move to Inbox, and move subtasks with it
commandPreview.statusWithChildren: Change status to {{status}}, and complete unfinished subtasks
commandPreview.addSubtask: Add a subtask and update the parent. A completed parent is reopened
commandPreview.deleteTasks: Move the tasks below to Trash together
commandPreview.restoreTasks: Restore tasks from this delete batch that are still in Trash. If the original list is unavailable, they return to Inbox
commandPreview.removeTag: Remove this tag from the tasks below and keep the tasks
commandPreview.updateParent: Update the parent link. A completed parent may reopen

imageSearch.title: Image search
imageSearch.description: Use Brave Image Search to give the assistant real images and sources. The key is stored on this workspace's server.
imageSearch.enterKey: Enter a Brave Image Search API key
imageSearch.managedByEnvironment: This key is managed by an environment variable. Update the service configuration.
imageSearch.unavailable: Until a key is set, the assistant will say that image search is unavailable.
imageSearch.saved: Image search key saved. The service is checked on the next search.

htmlBlocks.title: Interactive pages
htmlBlocks.description: Let the assistant put small pages you can click in a reply. A page runs in isolation: it cannot use the network or read app data, and it can only fill the input. You decide whether to send.
htmlBlocks.allow: Allow the assistant to use interactive pages
htmlBlocks.cdnLabel: Origins allowed to load scripts and styles
htmlBlocks.cdnHint: One https origin per line, for example https://cdn.jsdelivr.net. Only pinned versions can be loaded. Every other network request is blocked.

skillsCard.title: Skills
skillsCard.description: Create, import, and manage skills for the AI assistant.

mobileNavigation.title: Features
mobileNavigation.description: Choose shortcuts for the phone tab bar and drag to reorder. More stays pinned on the right.
mobileNavigation.atCapacity: You can show at most {{max}} shortcuts. Turn one off before turning another on.
mobileNavigation.saveFailed: Couldn't save. The previous settings were restored.

modelSettings.title: Model settings
modelSettings.description: Configure an OpenAI Chat Completions compatible service. The connection is tested before saving.
modelSettings.clearKeyDescription: Chat can't use the current model configuration until you add an API key again.

backup.title: Backup and restore
backup.description: A snapshot includes all workspace data (tasks, materials, conversations, and memory). Merge adds records that are missing and keeps ids that already exist here. Replace swaps the current database for the snapshot.
backup.mergeDescription: Existing ids stay as they are. Records missing here are added, and records that exist only here are kept. Settings and the login session stay put, and the service does not restart. A backup is saved first.
backup.replaceDescription: Current data is backed up first, then replaced with the snapshot. The service restarts briefly during the restore.

server.title: Server
server.serverMode: Connected to a self-hosted server. Every device shares this data.
server.localMode: Using data on this device. Switch to a self-hosted server to sync across devices (see the deployment docs).

cli.title: Local AI commands
cli.description: Find the Codex and Claude Code launch commands from the login shell. A manual absolute path takes priority, and auto-check will not overwrite it.
cli.keptManual: Kept the manual configuration. Auto-check also found: {{found}}
cli.restored: Switched back to the auto-discovered command.

topicList.empty: No lists yet. Create one to start.
topicList.title: Lists
topicList.subtitle: Keep related tasks together

topicModal.description: Enter a name to start adding tasks.
topicModal.name: List name
topicModal.descriptionPlaceholder: What outcome should this list produce?

trash.title: Trash
trash.description: Deleted tasks stay here. Restore returns them to their original list or to Inbox.

language.title: Language
language.description: Interface language. Follows your browser by default; your choice is saved on this device.
